messages:
maria (sec): Heads-up — vendor-led attack simulation scheduled for 2024-06-12 to 2024-06-13. We need to lock in RBAC windows, KMS evidence access, and a clear handoff for remediation + retest. Who can own the ops side?

alex (eng-infra): I can drive RBAC window + ephemeral role. Proposal: create an ephemeral assessor role scoped to namespace 'sim-assessor' with read-only logs + temporary S3 presigned access. 4h default window, extend by request.

sam (oncall): Sounds good. Can we require MFA + IP restriction for the window? Also need a runbook for oncall in case vendor triggers noisy alerts.

maria (sec): Yes to MFA and IP allowlist. Sam, can you draft the oncall runbook? Keep escalation to SecEng on high-severity findings.

anya (product): Quick Q — will the sim touch customer PII? If yes we need masking and a sanitized dataset or explicit consent from impacted customers.

maria (sec): Vendor confirmed scope excludes production PII; they will run against staging copy sanitized last week. We'll still log any accidental hits and trigger the data-handling checklist.

alex (eng-infra): For KMS access: rather than handing keys, we will provide a KMS-delegated decrypt proxy that returns evidence blobs with audit metadata. Assessor role gets permission: kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext + s3:GetObject on evidence-bucket. No raw keys shared.

john (ciso): +1 on delegation. Ensure CloudTrail records both the proxy service and KMS key usage. Retention for audit logs needs to be 1 year for this engagement. Also, tag all evidence objects with 'assessment=redwood-2024-attack-sim'.

maria (sec): Putting this here so we have an auditable checklist before the sim:
- Ephemeral assessor role created and reviewed by Alex
- IP allowlist + MFA enforced
- KMS proxy endpoint deployed; proxy logs to secure-bucket
- Audit retention set to 1y and snapshot exported to archive bucket
- Oncall runbook + escalation ladder ready
- Evidence packaging procedure documented (presigned URLs + tags)
- Retest window defined and retest owner assigned

alex (eng-infra): IAM snippet for role we'll use (minimal):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:DescribeLogGroups","logs:GetLogEvents"],"Resource":"arn:aws:logs:*:*:log-group:/staging/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"s3:GetObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::evidence-staging/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/assess-key"}
  ]
}
```

sam (oncall): For the runbook I'll add sections: noise thresholds, false-positive checklist, immediate mitigation steps, and contact matrix (sec lead + infra lead). ETA EOD Friday.

maria (sec): Thanks. One more ops question: retest cadence — vendor wants a 2-week retest window after fixes. Do we have capacity?

alex (eng-infra): Capacity-wise okay if we reserve the dedicated staging pool on those dates. I'll tentatively reserve 06-26 to 06-28. We should mark it 'do-not-deploy' for routine releases.

anya (product): We'll communicate the freeze to product teams and block merges to staging for that window.

maria (sec): I'll draft the intake ticket and remediation tracker. Minimal fields: vuln id, severity, owner, patch ETA, verification steps, evidence blob link, retest slot. Will post the template here.

john (ciso): Make sure the tracker links to the audit export snapshots and includes KMS usage entries. Also require an approval from SecEng before closing any high/critical items.

alex (eng-infra): evidence-bot: created evidence-bucket lifecycle + encryption.
evidence-bot: Ticket SEC-4932 created for attack simulation setup (includes IAM role, KMS proxy, and audit retention).

maria (sec): Great — next steps: Alex to create ephemeral role + KMS proxy, Sam to deliver runbook, I will publish remediation tracker and onboard vendor to the intake process. Follow-ups in #eng-security weekly sync. :thumbsup:

sam (oncall): A couple of tiny specifics I want to capture before handoff:
- Presigned URL TTL = 2h
- Evidence export format: gzip JSONL with metadata header
- Proxy logs must include request-id, principal, and key-id

maria (sec): Noted. I'll include those in the evidence packaging procedure. Closing for now — will bump when artifacts are ready for review.
